package everypath

import (
	"context"
	"net/http"

	"example.test/auth"
	"example.test/database"
	"example.test/httperr"
)

type figures interface {
	Read(ctx context.Context) ([]int, error)
}

type checked struct{}

func (checked) Read(ctx context.Context) ([]int, error) {
	if err := auth.Require(ctx); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return []int{1}, nil
}

type unwired struct{}

func (unwired) Read(ctx context.Context) ([]int, error) { return []int{1}, nil }

type Handlers struct {
	db     *database.DB
	source figures
}

func New() Handlers { return Handlers{source: checked{}} }

func checkedFigures(ctx context.Context) ([]int, error) { return checked{}.Read(ctx) }

func serve(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, figures func(context.Context) ([]int, error)) {
	out, err := figures(r.Context())
	if err != nil {
		httperr.Write(w, r, err)
		return
	}
	httperr.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, out)
}

func (h Handlers) GetInATransaction(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var out []int
	err := h.db.Tx(r.Context(), func(tx database.Tx) error {
		if err := auth.Require(r.Context()); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		out = []int{1}
		return nil
	})
	if err != nil {
		httperr.Write(w, r, err)
		return
	}
	httperr.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, out)
}

func (h Handlers) GetThroughTheWiredImplementation(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	serve(w, r, h.source.Read)
}

func (h Handlers) GetThroughACheckedCallback(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	serve(w, r, checkedFigures)
}

func (h Handlers) GetOnBothBranches(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.URL.Query().Get("scope") == "owner" {
		if err := auth.Require(r.Context()); err != nil {
			httperr.Write(w, r, err)
			return
		}
		httperr.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, []int{1})
		return
	}
	if allowed, _ := auth.IndividualPerformanceOf(r.Context()); !allowed {
		httperr.Write(w, r, auth.OffError{})
		return
	}
	httperr.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, []int{2})
}

// A check before the loop covers what the loop gathers.
func (h Handlers) GetEachRow(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if err := auth.Require(r.Context()); err != nil {
		httperr.Write(w, r, err)
		return
	}
	var out []int
	for _, row := range []int{1, 2} {
		out = append(out, row)
	}
	httperr.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, out)
}

// What a figure-free function answers needs no check.
func (h Handlers) GetTheCatalog(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	httperr.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, auth.Catalog())
}

type built struct {
	read func(context.Context) ([]int, error)
}

func newBuilt(read func(context.Context) ([]int, error)) built { return built{read: read} }

var wired = newBuilt(checkedFigures)

func checkedReader() func(context.Context) ([]int, error) {
	return func(ctx context.Context) ([]int, error) { return checkedFigures(ctx) }
}

// A field filled through a constructor's parameter resolves to what each
// call of the constructor passes, and a reader a function builds to what it
// returns.
func (h Handlers) GetThroughAConstructor(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	serve(w, r, wired.read)
}

func (h Handlers) GetThroughABuiltReader(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	serve(w, r, checkedReader())
}

var errUnknown = database.Wrap("unknown")

// A sentinel wrapped by another call is still a refusal.
func checkedUnlessUnknown(ctx context.Context, known bool) ([]int, error) {
	if !known {
		return nil, database.Stored(errUnknown)
	}
	return checkedFigures(ctx)
}

func (h Handlers) GetUnlessUnknown(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	out, err := checkedUnlessUnknown(r.Context(), r.URL == nil)
	if err != nil {
		httperr.Write(w, r, err)
		return
	}
	httperr.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, out)
}
